public_events: The game begins. 6 players are alive.

statements.text: I don't have much to go on yet, but I'll be watching who stays quiet.
Let's be careful not to rush. I'm just a regular villager trying to help.
Player2 sounds rehearsed to me. Why announce being a regular villager?
I'd like to hear more from everyone before I point fingers.
Honestly Player3 is the one pushing hard this early, that worries me.
I agree we should hear more. Player5, why jump on Player3 so fast?

public_events: Player3 was voted out. Player3 was a villager.
Player1 was killed in the night. Player1 was a villager.

statements.text: Losing Player1 hurts. I think Player6 has been oddly quiet about who to trust.
I'm the Seer. Last night I checked Player5 and they are on the wolves' side.
That's a convenient claim. Anyone can say they're the Seer.
Player4's claim fits how hard Player5 pushed yesterday. I'm voting Player5.

public_events: Player5 was voted out. Player5 was a werewolf.
Player4 was killed in the night. Player4 was a seer.

meta.description: 6 players, 2 wolves, night kills, a Seer who reveals
